item.text: {"criteria":[{"id":"BASELINE_STALE_BLOCKS_SCORE","observation":"T1 explicitly identifies the six-month-old demonstration build as stale and says it cannot support a defensible current-product score or replacement commitment; T2 and T3 continue to refuse a whole-product score because broader evidence and a rubric remain absent.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]},{"id":"BASELINE_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_WINS","observation":"After the inspected production evidence arrives, T2 makes it controlling for the observed incomplete-day journey, confirms editing, notifications, and the seven-step re-entry defect, and avoids extending that finding to other journeys. T3 preserves this boundary by listing performance across other journeys as unknown.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]},{"id":"BASELINE_REVISION_EXPLICIT","observation":"T3 explicitly names the inspected exact production revision and normal incomplete-day journey as the controlling baseline, withdraws the earlier uninspected/owner-reported and demo-representativeness claims, lists remaining unknowns, and proposes the bounded next move of prototyping and comparing a shortened incumbent re-entry flow without inventing a whole-product score.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]}]}
